shadowSentences: The sun is shining brightly today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Cooking new recipes is a fun activity for me.
I often take walks in the park near my house.
Learning a new language can be challenging yet rewarding.
Traveling to new places helps broaden your perspective.
Listening to music while studying can improve concentration.
Spending time with friends helps reduce stress and anxiety.
Having a hobby can enhance your happiness and well-being.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about your exercise routine?
Q2: What challenges do you face in maintaining a regular exercise schedule?
Q3: How do you think exercise impacts your overall well-being?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone trying to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about dietary habits.
questions: Q1: What does a typical day of meals look like for you?
Q2: Do you find it difficult to eat healthy when busy?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of a balanced diet?
Q4: What tips would you offer for someone wanting to improve their eating habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteering activities.
questions: Q1: Have you ever participated in any volunteer work?
Q2: What challenges did you encounter while volunteering?
Q3: How do you feel volunteering impacts the community?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone interested in volunteering?
